# Gst v4l2slh265dec observer contract (offline)

**AI disclosure:** Generated by AI. No device, mapping, or installation.

Parent [companion #82](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/82) and
[driver #42](https://github.com/iconidentify/libva-v4l2_request/issues/42) stay open.
This is the GStreamer direct-V4L2 child ([#96](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/96)).
The VA sibling is [#95](https://github.com/iconidentify/omarchy-m1-video/issues/95).

## Actual boundaries (pinned `070125524a8422e29d3b69a372ed4f62fd343ffa`)

Streaming submission is `gst_v4l2_request_queue` in `gstv4l2decoder.c`:
it QBUFs bitstream (`gst_v4l2_decoder_queue_sink_mem`) and picture
(`gst_v4l2_decoder_queue_src_buffer`), then `MEDIA_REQUEST_IOC_QUEUE`.
Pending requests live in `decoder->pending_requests`. Completion is
`gst_v4l2_request_set_done` / `VIDIOC_DQBUF`, not pipeline PAUSED.
`gst_v4l2_decoder_flush` is STREAMOFF/STREAMON of both pads; that recycles
buffers and must not run while this observer holds a request.
`gst_v4l2_request_free` closes the request fd and drops the decoder ref.

There is no pause API in the pinned client. This leaf adds a **default-off**
begin/end around those real functions. One DQBUF or GST_STATE_PAUSED is not
treated as a barrier.

Locking: the pinned request object is documented non-thread-safe. Tests are
single-threaded. A later multi-thread campaign must take the decoder object
lock before begin and before queue/free/flush.

## Receipts

On a successful patched queue, the observer records run, decoder identity,
request fd (allocation), generation (begin count), writer_job (monotonic),
and frame_num from the request. Historical POC/index labels are not used.
Exporter/cache/mapping stay unproven (vb2 CPU-access is a no-op at the kernel pin).

## Limits

Fake ioctl is allowed and identified. No `/dev/video*`, no dma-buf mmap, no
copy, no installed GStreamer change.
